method: Train-period-derived quantile indicator thresholds and intersections of 1-3 different features, plus up to 100 train-strong three-condition sets expanded to 4, evaluated on 5775 closed baseline 500 USDT portfolio trades. Zero-loss all90 search is POSTHOC only; frozen train+validation decisions evaluated on last 15d holdout.
warnings: Selected 500 USDT replay trades not exact real BloFin orders; historical TOP200 missing, fee/slide assumptions.
Only 14 pre-entry indicator features, not all OHLCV sequences or combinations.
Filters optimized on 90d hindsight cannot be called predictive; holdout is independent only for preselected rules.
No changes to LIVE, positions, GitHub main, exchange.
